rawContent: 1/2 If Biden can indeed win this, we have two years to fight for & win the senate. The majority of white women today are not accustomed to having to fight hard decade after decade for OUR OWN basic human rights. #BLM #Biden2020

2/2 For example, white women gained the right to vote in 1920 but women of color had to wait another 45 years! We must remember how long women of color, Black & brown, have fought & continue to fight for liberty & justice in this country. #BLM #Biden2020
